description: This file contains shell scripting code used for testing and simulating interactions with git, including setting up repository configurations, running hooks, and processing git push and receive-pack operations with detailed output verification.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test expectation that a given shell command sequence will succeed.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Mocks or verifies git hook execution with specific parameters.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Simulates a test utility for verifying interactions or outputs.

methods.name: packetize_raw
methods.description: Processes raw data for git packet format.

methods.name: packetize
methods.description: Wraps data into a git packet format.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output logs to be human-readable and stable for testing comparisons.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected outputs in testing.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares references in the repository for testing.
